headline: Week 2: Taylor Swift Wrote a Breakup Song About The Good Ladds
subhead: T swift's Baddies dropped 173, MassiveCocks dropped trou, and Mig left enough on his bench to win the league average.
matchOfTheWeek: Put an AR to My Head squeaked past OnlyFants by 11.28 in the only matchup that didn't feel like a hostage video. DK Metcalf went nuclear for 28.90 to bail Kyle out, while Derek Carr quietly dropped 22.82 from the bench — meaning Kyle won AND mismanaged his roster in the same breath. Cubby, taking an L while scoring 117 is a uniquely OnlyFants experience.
powerRankingsShakeup: T swift's Baddies and The Olave Garden are launching into the stratosphere while MassiveCocks and The Good Ladds are speed-running the Bender Bowl. Two weeks in and Mig already looks like he's drafting for 2026.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the crime scene: The Good Ladds 100.00. A clean, round, embarrassing hundo. Mig, you scored a Kyler Murray 28.54 and STILL got curb-stomped by 73 because you left Hunter Henry's 22.90 rotting on the bench like leftovers in a frat house fridge. Optimal lineup was 137.80 — you missed by 37 points and the playoffs by about three weeks of this nonsense. T swift's Baddies didn't even need to try; James Cook (28.5) and Davante (26) just showed up and clocked out.

Meanwhile in The Olave Garden, Patrick rode Alvin Kamara's 44-burger to 154.80 and STILL benched De'Von Achane and his 29.50. You scored 154 with one hand tied behind your back and Achane handcuffed in the trunk. MassiveCocks, on the other side of that beating, mustered 93.34 — Malik Nabers put up 28.70 and the rest of the roster collectively whispered. Papi, the team name is doing a lot of heavy lifting right now.

Stroud Boys posted a league-best 97.9% efficiency behind Marvin Harrison's 29, which is the nerdiest flex in the league but congrats Bjewett, you finally read the start/sit column. Hot Cocks ate it for 33. LargestofRocks beat 226 Alpha by 37 while leaving FORTY-THREE bench points between Quentin Johnston and Sam Darnold — imagine starting a Darnold/QJ stack in 2024 and being mad you didn't. Szara, Jalen Hurts went for 24.82 and you still got smoked; that's a roster problem, not a bad week.

Jets' Juniors handled Bo Nix Celli 151-134 in a game where Chris Godwin's 24.70 wasn't enough to save Nick from himself. Welcome to 0-2 watch, gentlemen. The bottom is getting crowded.

weeklyAwards.title: Kamara Carry Special
weeklyAwards.blurb: Alvin Kamara dropped 44 and Achane dropped 29.50 on the bench — Patrick won by 61 and somehow still cost himself points.

weeklyAwards.blurb: 93.34 is not 'massive,' Papi — that's a soft open at best.
